statement.p: Find area of the region under the curve y = 2 x^3 - 8 and above the x-axis, for 3 \le x \le 8.

static.solution:
(Click on the graph for a larger version.)
The area we want is that above the x-axis and under the function, for 3 \le x \le 8. Thus we need to find \int_{3}^{8} (2 x^3 - 8) dx \approx 1967.5. We can find the area in a number of ways, the easiest of which is to use a graphing calculator.
